minifin.source: MiniFin — 48 hpf, Parse Evercode, 43 drug samples — de-novo Leiden res 1.0 on Harmony embedding (HVG->PCA->Harmony[sample])
minifin.recipe: HVG → PCA → Harmony(sample) → kNN graph → Leiden resolution sweep
minifin.noGtNote: Internal reference — no published labels; intuition-building, not a benchmark.

consistency.framing: Consistency, not accuracy — the prior is an automated internal annotation, not ground truth.
consistency.celltypeNote: Cell-type differences are mostly granularity (the labeler stays coarse where it won't guess an ungroundable subtype) plus prior-annotation errors.

adjudication.note: On the 7 hardest cross-lineage conflicts, grounded adjudication on each cluster's own enriched markers: the labeler's call was better-supported more often than the prior's — including its one genuine miss (c30 enterocyte, actually pronephric tubule).

zscape.source: ZSCAPE Saunders et al. (de-novo leiden + silhouette-gated sub-split)
zscape.recipe: silhouette-gated sub-Leiden on the published embedding (adaptive per branch)
zscape.selectionNote: ZSCAPE uses silhouette-gated sub-Leiden (adaptive per-branch), not a flat resolution sweep.

notes: In-paradigm validation: sci-RNA-seq3, ZSCAPE-derived label space — home-turf, not generalization.

chemfish.source: ChemFish Barkan et al. (CHEM10 DSP + CHEM11 BS3) — 48 hpf subset, de-novo Leiden res 3.0 on Harmony(expt) embedding
chemfish.recipe: HVG → PCA → Harmony(experiment) → kNN graph → Leiden resolution sweep

notes: Correction: 87.7% tissue supersedes the earlier withheld 31% — that was a :5007-misalignment artifact (ChemFish was served MiniFin's stats), now fixed.

daniocell.source: DanioCell Sur et al. (Farrell/NICHD) — 36-72hpf window, de-novo Leiden res 2.0 on Harmony(stage) embedding
daniocell.recipe: HVG → PCA → Harmony(stage) → kNN graph → Leiden resolution sweep

notes: Genuinely INDEPENDENT / cross-platform (10X droplet) — the real generalization read.
Coarse: scored on tissue + broad only (≤43-level; numeric clust-codes are not a nameable vocabulary, excluded) — coarse-resolution generalization, not fine.

megafin.source: MegaFin Part 1 REBUILD — 48 hpf TuWT, 93 drug samples (Manual/Lawson object) — de-novo Leiden res 2.0 (84 clusters; C67 periderm fragment merged into C61) on the carried Harmony(sample) embedding. Standard re-embed tested and REJECTED (coherence collapsed); Parse embedding retained. Supersedes the 77-cluster Parse interim.
megafin.recipe: HVG → PCA → carried Harmony(sample) embedding → kNN graph → Leiden sweep
megafin.noGtNote: Internal drug-screen atlas (Manual build) — no published labels; intuition-building, not a benchmark.
megafin.design: 46 drugs × 2 doses (1 µM & 5 µM) + 4 controls · 48 hpf TuWT whole embryos
megafin.coherenceNote: Less coherent (0.929) than the GT partitions (~1.0) — this 93-condition drug screen needs the Parse embedding; the standard HVG→PCA→Harmony re-embed was tested and rejected (coherence collapsed to ~0.67).
megafin.groundingNote: 100.0% of markers queryable on :5007; 95.6% under canonical ZFIN names (thinner than the ENSDARG-native sets, but key cell-type markers ground fine).

rejectedReembed.note: Standard re-embed (HVG→PCA→Harmony→neighbors): coherence collapsed to 0.475–0.667 with 56–63 micro-clusters — worse than the Parse embedding. Rejected.

noGtScorecard.badge: No published labels — not an accuracy benchmark
noGtScorecard.abstentionNote: All 4 abstentions justified — and it declined c23, a 4,131-cell cluster, because it is a ribosome-high / low-complexity technical artifact, not a size call. It knows the difference between a cell type it can't resolve and a cluster it shouldn't label.

megafin_parse.source: MegaFin Part 1 — 48 hpf TuWT, 93 drug samples — de-novo Leiden res 3.0 on Parse Harmony embedding (sidecar:megafin_leiden_labels.csv)
megafin_parse.recipe: Leiden resolution sweep on the Parse/Trailmaker Harmony(sample) embedding
megafin_parse.noGtNote: Internal drug-screen atlas (Parse pipeline build) — no published labels; intuition-building, not a benchmark.
megafin_parse.design: 46 drugs × 2 doses (1 µM & 5 µM) + 4 controls · 48 hpf TuWT whole embryos

notes: Scored in each dataset's own native schema — not cross-dataset comparable; no head-to-head ranking.
Semantic-judge floor: misses are near-dominated (right lineage, sub-resolution), so true quality runs higher — especially ChemFish sub.
Abstains only on under-powered or technical-artifact clusters, never reliable ones, and flags likely reference errors — it knows what it doesn't know.
